text:
maya: Quick pre-QBR checkpoint for MistralWorks — activation ramp next month looks healthy but cost spike risk on embeddings. Can folks confirm forecast and enablement schedule?
alex: I'll pull the 7/30-day token burn and run a per-route breakdown. ETA 30m.
samir: Noted — are we using cached prefixes for their chat flows? That was the biggest win last time.
leo: Yes, prod config has prefix caching enabled but their dev sends very long system prompts which kills batching. We suggested truncation in enablement.
maya: Good — can we get a conservative spend forecast (90th percentile) for the QBR deck? We need to recommend a retainer cushion.
eng-enable: @maya booking 2 enablement sessions: onboarding deep-dive (wk of 05/03) and prompt engineering workshop (wk of 05/10). Sending invites.
billing-bot: ALERT: MistralWorks (acct 71-443) projected spend next 30d = $9.8k (baseline), $15.2k (90th pct). Remaining credits: $4.1k.
alex: quick SQL I ran: ```SELECT route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, AVG(latency) FROM usage WHERE acct=71 GROUP BY route;``` Top routes: chat-api (72%), embed-bulk (18%).
samir: So embed-bulk is the mover. Are they running 1536-dim embs? Might be cheaper to switch to 512-dim with some loss. Recommend AB test.
leo: Also flagged: their retry client bursts at midnight causing short-term concurrency spikes. That's pushing us into higher batch sizes and thence cost. Can CS advise devs to rate-limit retries?
maya: Action list: 1) Alex upload a conservative spend slide + per-route table. 2) Eng-enable to confirm session times and send prompts homework. 3) Samir/Leo propose 512-dim trial with expected cost delta. 4) CS propose a retainer cushion recommendation.
alex: Uploaded spend snapshot to drive: https://redwood.app/drive/mistralworks/qbr/spend-snapshot (will append raw CSV).
eng-enable: Added invite, also created a short prework doc: "Prompt length hygiene" — link in calendar.
samir: I can draft an AB test plan: control=1536, treatment=512, run for 7 days, track quality lift/regress on 5 canonical prompts.
leo: FYI ops: If they agree to smaller dims we need a model variant mapping change. I'll coord with runtime to stage the variant.
maya: Great. Last ask: if we recommend a retainer bump, please include cost delta and rationale in bullet points for execs. Try to have slides by EOD tomorrow.
alex: Will post the 90th/median numbers + delta slide by 18:00 PT.
billing-bot: NOTE: Created budget-alert rule draft (threshold 80% of retainer). Review: https://redwood.app/alerts/71-443
maya: Thanks all. If anything urgent ping me 1:1. :thumbsup:
